title: iYup uptime overview
description: What is down and why, when it happened, latency, early warnings, and the health of the monitoring pipeline itself.

panels.title: Up
panels.description: Targets a majority of regions see up.

targets.expr: count(((max by (target) (iyup:target_up:quorum{target=~"$target"}) + max by (target) (iyup:target_degraded:quorum{target=~"$target"})) or max by (target) (iyup:target_up:quorum{target=~"$target"}) or max by (target) (ping_up{target=~"$target"})) >= 1) or vector(0)

panels.title: Down
panels.description: Targets a majority of regions see down, after retries. Lights up when any target is down.

targets.expr: count(((max by (target) (iyup:target_up:quorum{target=~"$target"}) + max by (target) (iyup:target_degraded:quorum{target=~"$target"})) or max by (target) (iyup:target_up:quorum{target=~"$target"}) or max by (target) (ping_up{target=~"$target"})) == 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Slow
panels.description: Targets that are up but slower than their degraded_after threshold in most regions.

targets.expr: count(((max by (target) (iyup:target_up:quorum{target=~"$target"}) + max by (target) (iyup:target_degraded:quorum{target=~"$target"})) or max by (target) (iyup:target_up:quorum{target=~"$target"}) or max by (target) (ping_up{target=~"$target"})) == 2) or vector(0)

panels.title: Stale
panels.description: Target checks older than their staleness budget (ping_stale_after_seconds). Their state is unknown: an agent may be stuck or overloaded.

panels.title: Alerts firing
panels.description: Prometheus alerts currently firing, all rules, not counting the always-on Watchdog heartbeat.

panels.title: Uptime, time range
panels.description: Average share of time each selected target was up (by region majority) over the dashboard time range.

panels.title: Targets
panels.description: One row per configured target. State is the majority verdict of the regions (UP, SLOW, DOWN; PENDING before the first check); last result is the latest check's outcome. Failing regions counts regions that disagree. Budget left is the 30-day error budget remaining. 'In state for' counts from the last up/down change or the agent's last restart, whichever is later (the status page reconciles it with outage history). 'Checked' is the age of that check. Uptime covers the dashboard time range.

targets.expr: (max by (target) (iyup:target_up:quorum{target=~"$target"}) + max by (target) (iyup:target_degraded:quorum{target=~"$target"})) or max by (target) (iyup:target_up:quorum{target=~"$target"}) or max by (target) (ping_up{target=~"$target"})

panels.title: Up / down over time
panels.description: The majority verdict across regions per target, after retries; SLOW means up but slower than its threshold. Gaps mean no data.

targets.expr: (max by (target) (iyup:target_up:quorum{target=~"$target"}) + max by (target) (iyup:target_degraded:quorum{target=~"$target"})) or max by (target) (iyup:target_up:quorum{target=~"$target"}) or max by (target) (ping_up{target=~"$target"})

panels.title: By region
panels.description: Each region's own verdict. A target failing in one region while the others succeed is a regional problem (TargetRegionalFailure), not an outage.

panels.title: Error budget left, 30 days
panels.description: Share of each target's 30-day error budget (1 - objective) not yet spent. Young installs have less than 30 days of data; the budget is still the whole window's.

panels.title: Burn rate, 1 hour
panels.description: How fast each target spends its error budget: 1 is exactly sustainable for 30 days. ErrorBudgetBurnFast pages above 14.4 (with the 5-minute window agreeing).

panels.title: p95 response latency
panels.description: 95th percentile latency of checks that received an HTTP response, over a rolling 5 minute window. Failed connections are excluded so they cannot make a dead target look fast.

panels.title: Where the latest check's time went
panels.description: Connection phases of each target's latest check. 'Server' is the remainder: time from an open connection to the response headers. Keep-alives are off, so every check pays the full DNS + TCP + TLS cost.

targets.expr: clamp_min(max by (target) (ping_last_latency_seconds{target=~"$target"}) - (max by (target) (ping_dns_duration_seconds{target=~"$target"}) or 0 * max by (target) (ping_last_latency_seconds{target=~"$target"})) - (max by (target) (ping_connect_duration_seconds{target=~"$target"}) or 0 * max by (target) (ping_last_latency_seconds{target=~"$target"})) - (max by (target) (ping_tls_duration_seconds{target=~"$target"}) or 0 * max by (target) (ping_last_latency_seconds{target=~"$target"})), 0)

panels.title: Retries per hour
panels.description: Attempts the agent had to retry, as an hourly rate over 5 minutes. A target that stays up but keeps needing retries is degrading before it goes down.

panels.title: TLS certificate days left
panels.description: From each HTTPS target's latest check. CertificateExpiringSoon fires below 14 days; negative means expired.

panels.title: Domain registration days left
panels.description: From RDAP, refreshed twice a day for the domains listed in the targets file. DomainExpiringSoon fires below 30 days.

panels.title: ping-agents up
panels.description: Agents (regions) Prometheus can scrape. With none, nothing is checked (AllPingAgentsDown); with fewer, the quorum rests on fewer votes.

panels.title: api-gateway
panels.description: Can Prometheus scrape the status API? If not, the status page is down (ApiGatewayDown).

panels.title: Shortest interval
panels.description: The most frequent check interval among the targets.

panels.title: Longest stale budget
panels.description: The largest staleness budget among the targets: two intervals plus one worst-case check (all retries timing out).

panels.title: Age of each target's last check
panels.description: A healthy agent draws a sawtooth that resets every interval. A line climbing through the dashed limit means checks have stopped finishing.

panels.title: Status API requests
panels.description: Requests to the api-gateway by route template and status code.

panels.title: Status API p95 latency
panels.description: How long the api-gateway takes to answer, by route. /history and /outages query Prometheus and are cached for PROMETHEUS_QUERY_CACHE_SECONDS.
